parsed.rationale: The two computed properties `HSBColor.uiColor` (line 53) and `HSBColor.nsColor` (line 63) in `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift` are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.71) because they both convert the same `HSBColor` value type to a platform color, but they target distinct platform types — `UIColor` (UIKit/iOS) and `NSColor` (AppKit/macOS) respectively. These are intentional platform-specific adaptors that must remain separate; collapsing them would require conditional compilation noise that is harder to read than two short parallel properties. No restraint markers are present, but the divergence is domain-driven rather than accidental.
